title: From Gross-Manes to Alday-Maldacena
summary: Minimal surfaces govern the classical limit of several important observables in string theory. Two basic examples are the Gross--Manes saddle for high-energy string scattering in flat space and the Alday--Maldacena surface for gluon scattering at strong coupling in ${\cal N}=4$ SYM. In this paper we study a family of null polygonal minimal surfaces in AdS interpolating between these two regimes by moving the cusps from a small region deep in the bulk to the AdS boundary.
